author: Nozizwe Herero
illustrator: 小小绘本馆 · 新版矢量插画（原作：Siya Masuku）
description_zh: 小鸡黛西想飞，嘲笑和失败让她难过，妈妈的支持陪她继续尝试。适合讨论愿望、挫折与鼓励。

pages.image_alt: 黄色小鸡黛西站在小农场的鸡舍前，远处是村庄。
pages.text_zh: 从前，在一个小村庄附近的小农场里，住着一只名叫黛西的小鸡。
pages.text_original: Once upon a time on a little farm near a little village there lived a little chicken called Daisy.

pages.image_alt: 黛西张开小翅膀指向天空，三只小鸡在一旁笑。
pages.text_zh: “等我长大了，我要飞得高高的，飞上天空！”黛西说。可是，其他小鸡都笑了起来。
pages.text_original: “When I grow up, I want to fly high, high into the sky,” Daisy said. But all the other chickens laughed at her.

pages.image_alt: 鸡妈妈用翅膀搂着黛西，其他小鸡站在远处。
pages.text_zh: “你真奇怪。”它们说，“我们再也不跟你玩了。”妈妈告诉她：“黛西，我们都会扑扇翅膀，可是鸡要飞起来很不容易。”
pages.text_original: “You are so weird,” they said. “We won’t play with you anymore.” “Daisy, we can all flap our wings but it’s very difficult for chickens to fly,” Mama told her.

pages.image_alt: 黛西独自在鸡舍旁扑扇翅膀，两只脚仍在地面。
pages.text_zh: 黛西不肯放弃。每天，她都独自练习扑扇翅膀。扑扇，扑扇，扑扇！可她还是飞不离地面。
pages.text_original: Daisy wouldn’t give up. Every day she practised by herself, flapping her wings. Flap, flap, flap, she would flap her wings but she couldn’t lift off the ground.

pages.image_alt: 云朵形想象画面中，黛西飞过麻雀和燕子，农场在下面。
pages.text_zh: 练习的时候，她想象自己飞上高空，低头看着地面上的小鸡。她想象自己飞过麻雀，飞过燕子。“哇！”鸟儿们会说，“一只会飞的鸡！”
pages.text_original: While she practised, she imagined herself flying high into the sky and looking at the chickens below. She imagined herself flying past the sparrows and past the swallows. “Wow!” the birds would say. “A chicken that can fly!”

pages.image_alt: 黛西从低处跳起又落向软草，翅膀用力扑扇。
pages.text_zh: 于是，扑扇，扑扇，扑扇！黛西每天都练习。她离开了地面，却又跌落下来。
pages.text_original: So ... Flap, flap, flap, every day Daisy would flap her wings. She would lift off the ground but fall down again.

pages.image_alt: 黛西眼含泪水靠在鸡妈妈身边，妈妈俯身安慰她。
pages.text_zh: “我永远也飞不起来！”黛西哭着对妈妈说，“它们说得对。”妈妈说：“黛西，你和其他小鸡不一样。它们不想飞，可是你想！你能做到。”
pages.text_original: “I’m never going to fly!” Daisy cried to Mama. “The others are right.” “Daisy, you are different from the other chickens. They don’t want to fly but you do! You can do it,” Mama said.

pages.image_alt: 黛西从矮鸡舍屋顶扑向空中，身后留下起飞的轨迹。
pages.text_zh: 第二天，黛西爬上鸡舍顶。扑扇，扑扇，扑扇！她飞到了半空中，不停地扑扇翅膀，扑扇呀，扑扇呀，然后……
pages.text_original: The following day Daisy climbed to the top of the chicken coop and flap, flap, flap, she flapped her wings. She flew into the air and flapped her wings ... and flapped her wings ... and flapped her wings and ...

pages.image_alt: 黛西落在松软草堆里，三只小鸡在一旁笑。
pages.text_zh: 砰！黛西又落到了地上。其他小鸡哈哈大笑：“我们早就说过，鸡不会飞！”
pages.text_original: BAM! The other chickens laughed out loud.“Ha ha ha! We told you! Chickens can’t fly!”

pages.image_alt: 黛西从更高的圆屋草顶起飞，风托着她的翅膀。
pages.text_zh: 可是，再过一天，黛西爬得更高，一直爬到了圆屋的屋顶上。扑扇，扑扇，扑扇！她飞到了半空中，不停地扑扇翅膀，扑扇呀，扑扇呀，然后……
pages.text_original: But the next day Daisy climbed even higher, right up to the top of the rondavel. Flap, flap, flap, Daisy flapped her wings. She flew into the air and flapped her wings ... and flapped her wings ... and flapped her wings and ...

pages.image_alt: 黛西展开翅膀在云间飞翔，麻雀和燕子陪在两侧。
pages.text_zh: 她真的一直在飞！翅膀下面的风越来越有力，她越飞越高。麻雀和燕子说：“太神奇了！一只会飞的鸡！”
pages.text_original: She kept flying! The wind beneath her wings grew stronger and she flew higher and higher! The sparrows and the swallows said, “Amazing! A flying chicken!”

pages.image_alt: 小鸡们站在鸡舍顶张开翅膀，抬头望着空中的黛西。
pages.text_zh: 其他小鸡也想像她一样。它们说：“哦，黛西，你真了不起！”
pages.text_original: And the other chickens wanted to be just like her. They said, “Oh Daisy, you’re amazing!”
